headline: A week of dinners, planned in one go.

regions.fits: A week stacks up in layers, so Pantry's code sits in bands.

texts.text: Every bar is a part of Pantry, as many as its code. The black bars are the plan.

notes.title: How it works
notes.text: Save the recipes you already cook. Pantry fills the week from them, suggests a few new ones, and builds the shopping list from what the plan needs.

notes.title: Every Monday
notes.text: At 8 in the morning Pantry emails you the week's plan, so the first dinner is decided before the day starts.

notes.title: Yours alone
notes.text: Sign in with your own account. Your recipes, plans and lists are saved to it, and you can pick up the week on any device.
